title: APAC touring platform Triangle raises $15m as Live Nation veteran joins leadership
summary: Touring and festival producer Triangle Group has announced a $15m (€12.9m) fundraising round as well as the appointment of former Live Nation APAC president Roger Field. The funding comprises an $10m (€8.6m) equity seed round led by DSG Consumer Partners, plus a $5m (€4.3m) venture debt from Genesis Alternative Ventures. Announcing the financing, Triangle called it “the largest institutional investment in Asia’s experience economy by a homegrown operator”. title: Conference news: Riga Music Week returns to convene growing Baltic industry
summary: Riga Music Week will return for its second edition from 4–6 November 2026, with organisers confirming the showcase lineup for the Latvian conference. The most represented genres are indie rock, followed by rock and metal, with the showcases completed with electronic, pop, and jazz artists. title: Live Nation to convert San Diego landmark to 4,000-cap venue
summary: Live Nation is to restore the famed San Diego Wonder Bread building into a new 4,000-capacity live venue, which it says “fills a gap in the San Diego music scene”. The plans for the site in Petco Park include restoration and preservation of the building’s historic façade, renovating its historic silo and the building of modern production capacity into the existing structure, with opening date set for 2028.
